description: The fast way (seconds) to SEE the app: with appBundleId/androidAppId it launches the installed app fresh and returns a screenshot plus the accessibility tree of the screen it lands on; with no target it photographs whatever is on the booted simulator right now (tree:true returns the accessibility tree instead). No exploration, no findings. Use appLaunchArgs/appLaunchEnv for a login bypass or backend override. For a screen reached by signing in or several taps, use tapp_session. Pass `capture` (an id, a path, or "latest") to read a finished run instead of a live app: its screens with the moment each was reached, `at` for one screen's frame, `frames:true` for contact sheets that make a recording cheap to scan.

androidAppId.description: Android: application id on a connected emulator/device

apkPath.description: Android: optional APK to install first

appBundleId.description: iOS: bundle id of the installed app

at.description: With capture: pull the frame for one screen, by index ("3") or screen name ("Checkout")

capture.description: Read a FINISHED run instead of a live app: a capture id, a capture directory, or "latest". Returns the screens it observed with the moment each was reached.

clearData.description: Android: clear app data before launch

frames.description: With capture: contact sheets — many frames per image, for scanning a recording cheaply instead of one frame at a time

tree.description: No target: return the accessibility tree of the current screen instead of a screenshot

name: tapp_look
title: See one screen
